title: 곤충 다시 그리기 3장 (2026-10-24)
intro: 1 = 넓적사슴벌레 암컷(큰턱 짧게) · 2 = 장수하늘소 수컷(큰턱 집게 모양) · 3 = 넓적사슴벌레 알비노 스킨(새 수컷 그림을 기준으로 색만). 가로 3자세 한 장(대기 · 공격 · 피격), 가장자리에 여백. 첫 그림 = 화풍 기준, (있으면) 두 번째 = 실물 사진.

items.title: 넓적사슴벌레 암컷 (다시)
items.note: 1차: 큰턱이 수컷처럼 김 = 틀림 · 2차: 피격 자세가 뒤집혀 배를 보임 = 틀림. 짧은 집게 + 피격은 옆모습으로 기울기만.
items.prompt: Use the first attached image only as the art style reference (painting style, eyes, outline, palette). Its subject is deliberately a different creature: copy only the brushwork, outline, lighting and palette, never its shape, pose or composition. Do NOT copy its anatomy. The second attached image is a real photo for anatomy reference: follow its body shape and colours, but where it differs from the description below, the description wins. Character pose sheet of the same insect: a FEMALE flat stag beetle (Dorcus titanus castanicolor): black, very flat and broad oval body, SMALL narrow head, mandibles TINY and stubby — shorter than the head itself, just two small pincer tips that barely poke out in front of the face, NEVER long, NEVER curved, NEVER toothed jaws (a previous drawing gave her male-like long jaws, which is wrong — she must look jawless at a glance), elytra glossy with fine lengthwise lines, short elbowed antennae with a small club. In the right-hand (hit) pose she stays ON HER LEGS seen from the side, tilted back and off balance — NEVER flipped onto her back, NEVER showing the belly (a previous drawing flipped her over, which is wrong). Anatomy rules: exactly six legs (three on the near side, three partly hidden on the far side), correct antennae for this species, no extra horns or spikes. Three poses in one horizontal row, identical creature at identical size standing on the same ground line, strict side profile facing right, evenly spaced with wide even gaps, no dividing lines, no panel borders, no numbers, no labels, no words anywhere, plain flat pale sage-green background; left: standing idle, weight settled, all legs planted, calm ready stance; center: lunging seize, short stubby mandibles thrown wide open and reaching out to clamp, front of the body reared up; right: recoiling from a heavy hit, knocked backward and tilted up, legs buckling underneath, head thrown back, off balance, still seen from the side (NOT belly-up). Cozy naturalist cartoon, semi-realistic stylized, soft warm golden-hour lighting, gentle rim light, hand-painted storybook texture, clean readable silhouette, mobile game art, crisp high detail, no text, no watermark. Leave a clear empty margin around every pose: mandible tips, antennae, legs and wings must be fully inside the picture, nothing touching or cut off by the image edges. Wide 3:1 image.
